# Sinoi the Fisherman

> An active, touch-first pixel-art fishing game made in Godot 4.7 and set in the world of the #HusbandOutWorld light novel series. Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases, and open source. It's in pre-production; production starts in Q1 2027. Android first, with a browser version that installs as an app.

Players fight each fish in a small trackpad-like "fight box": they trace the fish, tap and release on cue, flick against runs, spin to reel, and later use two fingers. A shadow copy of the box shows what their fingers cover. Bait decides what bites and tackle is how you beat the hardest fish, as in Stardew Valley's fishing. Sessions are short and active: no idle progress, no timers, no gacha. Fishing spots, fish and hazards come from the canon lore of Vraki, such as the docks of Sanbi and the legendary True Sanbi King. The game is made for touch screens; the browser version works with a mouse for testing.

The current build is a pre-production shell: a title screen, placeholder catches, a two-finger fight-box touch test, and JSON save export and import.

## Website

- [Home](https://deovandski.github.io/Sinoi-the-fisherman/): what the game is, where it stands, how to install it as an app, saves, docs and lore links
- [Play](https://deovandski.github.io/Sinoi-the-fisherman/play/): the browser build (needs JavaScript and WebGL; the game is drawn on a canvas, so it has no readable text)
- [Privacy](https://deovandski.github.io/Sinoi-the-fisherman/privacy.html): no accounts, cookies, analytics, ads or tracking; saves and offline game files stay on the device
- [Full text of the site](https://deovandski.github.io/Sinoi-the-fisherman/llms-full.txt): the pages above in one plain-text file

## Docs (on GitHub)

- [Source code](https://github.com/Deovandski/Sinoi-the-fisherman): the Godot project, website and build workflows

- [Illustrator brief](https://github.com/Deovandski/Sinoi-the-fisherman/blob/main/docs/art/illustrator-brief.md): sprite sizes, animation and Godot export rules
